references.text: The Jabbok River is mentioned as the border of the children of Ammon, just as in Deuteronomy 3:16
Moses gave the land of Gilead to the tribes of Reuben and Gad, as described in this text
Describes Sihon's territory from the Arnon Valley to the Jabbok River, matching the border description
Joshua describes the inheritance of Reuben and Gad east of the Jordan, including the Gilead area
The Jabbok River is first mentioned here in connection with Jacob's journey, the same river that forms the border
Jephthah refers to Israel's conquest of the land from Arnon to the Jabbok, the same area given to Reuben and Gad
The Arnon Valley and the border toward the children of Ammon are mentioned in connection with Israel's conquest of the land
